fact: At a launch restoring civil fingerprinting and national-number issuance for all ages, the director of the General Administration of the Civil Registry, Police Major General Tariq Ali Taha Sourij, said its staff were carrying out a comprehensive plan to develop and modernise the systems and that the national data had been recovered in full by Sudanese engineers of the technology and information department under the direct supervision of the Minister of Interior and the director general of police; the head of the Passports and Civil Registry Authority credited the Ministry of Interior and police headquarters with providing all the technical and logistical requirements. The article says 'today' and carries no date in its text, so the publication date reported for it (10 April 2025) is used.
title: الشرطة تعلن إستعادة خدمة طال انتظارها بالسجل المدني
